questions.question: How does Psalm 84 describe God's dwelling place?
options: Fearful; the psalmist trembles before the great holiness of God
Crowded; the psalmist marvels at the throngs of pilgrims
Lovely; the psalmist's soul longs for the courts of the LORD
Distant; the psalmist mourns far from the house of God
questions.answer: Lovely; the psalmist's soul longs for the courts of the LORD

questions.question: How does the psalm compare a day in God's courts?
options: Too short to satisfy the soul
Worth more than the finest gold

questions.question: The psalm says even the sparrow finds a home and the swallow a nest near God's altars.
How lovely is your dwelling place, O LORD of _____!
Blessed are those whose strength is in you, whose hearts are set on _____.
